audit_basis: full source audit of research/campaign3b-diagnostics tree (v16.4.10+3B.3); every entry cites file:line evidence in this checkout, not README claims

severity_scale.P0: produces wrong scientific verdicts or destroys evidence
severity_scale.P1: measurement integrity gap or missing required mechanism

status_scale.CLOSED: repair implemented, integrated, and covered by a passing regression test
status_scale.CLOSED-E: repair implemented; covered by executed evidence + unit tests

defects.evidence: equals/one_of/json_field_equals routed through the v1 casefold oracle — wrong-case answers scored correct in the declarative path
defects.root_cause: ops written against the legacy oracle; matching semantics implicit
defects.repair: versioned centralized matching (MATCH_STRICT default, MATCH_NORMALIZED only when a verify spec declares match:'normalized'; unknown semantics raise — strict never silently falls back); DECLARATIVE_EVALUATOR_VERSION=declarative-evaluator-v2 binds the contract; legacy exact_match retained for provenance and explicit opt-in only
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_evaluators.py (20 tests)

defects.evidence: KL was computed over positions predicting PROMPT tokens — the response continuation the term exists to protect was never constrained
defects.root_cause: the KL set was a bare prompt list; no verified answer or frozen continuation was teacher-forced
defects.repair: response-aware teacher-forced KL: kl_examples are verified {prompt,response} pairs encoded via supervised_tokens; kl_prompts derive the FROZEN model's own greedy continuations (adapter-disabled generate) and teacher-force them; the KL mask is labels[:,1:]!=-100 over logits[:,:-1] (causal alignment), float32 log-softmax, adapter-disabled reference = the same base weights whose digest is bound into the receipt (kl_scope=response_continuations, kl_set_digest, kl_reference_sources, n_kl_evaluations); receipt hygiene fixed: kl_prompts_digest binds the raw prompt strings (matching the runner's prompts_digest) and stays null when no bare prompts were given
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_trainer_protocol.py (4 KL tests) + executed run results/campaign3b2/runs/v40-verify-s0 (60 KL evaluations, nonzero measured term)

defects.evidence: default rehearsal pool drew frozen-correct rows from the SAME families being trained (rehearsing the capability under acquisition); custom corpora skipped the frozen-correct check
defects.root_cause: capability exclusion unspecified; custom path unverified
defects.repair: default pool = frozen-verified-correct rows from families NOT under training (plus preservation-style material), excluding hidden/retention/security; custom --rehearsal-corpus rows pass the identical frozen-correct membership check under the strict oracle; empty verified pool fails the run; pool digests + rejection counts bound into run_config and metrics; run_campaign1.py now performs the identical frozen-model strict-oracle membership check on the campaign lane (PRESERVATION_VERIFICATION.json per seed), rejecting trained-family rows and failing the seed on an empty verified pool — require_verified_rehearsal is enforced, not just declared
defects.regression_test: executed run results/campaign3b2/runs/v40-verify-s0 — rehearsal_pool metrics record excluded families, 2 verified pairs, 30 rejected

defects.evidence: existing-run collision detection ran AFTER corpus parse + tokenizer/model-config loading
defects.root_cause: run identity depended on the prompt-contract digest (needs the tokenizer)
defects.repair: run identity minted from cheap inputs (families/steps/rank/lr/seed/contrast/model+spec digests); destination refusal + .staging-{run_id} reservation happen before torch/transformers load; atomic os.replace publish; FAILED runs get RUN_COMMIT.json status FAILED
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_fit_runner_integrity.py

defects.evidence: configs pointed at a corpus that did not exist; v166 plans also refused empty final_holdout_digest; validation partition bound but never evaluated; no compositional split existed anywhere
defects.root_cause: configs committed ahead of their sealed corpus
defects.repair: deterministic generator scripts/gen_campaign3d.py produces train/validation/hidden/retention/security/compositional (413 rows + 64 sealed holdout rows at configs/holdout/campaign3b_holdout.jsonl); DatasetPartitionSetV3 binds the compositional split with enforced disjointness; runner+qualifier evaluate/rescore validation+compositional blocks for v4.0 corpora; final_holdout_digest bound into both configs; protocol_version: v2
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_dataset_v3.py; generator --check verifies V3 disjointness

defects.evidence: hidden rows scored via direct strict-oracle calls — a row with a verify spec would be scored by the wrong authority
defects.root_cause: score_row introduced after those lanes were written
defects.repair: both lanes route per-row scoring through score_row
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_evaluators.py::test_score_row_dispatches_verify_declarative_strict

defects.evidence: accuracy() casefolded — the live diagnostic could overstate strict-match correctness
defects.root_cause: v1-era consumer never migrated
defects.repair: recomputed accuracies use exact_match_strict; labeled as the metric of record
defects.regression_test: covered by strict-evaluator tests; report output labeled

defects.evidence: missing evaluation/qualification authority keys left decision=QUALIFIED with exit code 0 — an unsigned record read as success
defects.root_cause: signing failures appended after the decision was computed and never flipped it
defects.repair: when either role key is unavailable the decision is forced to INVALID_EVIDENCE with explicit reasons before any record is signed or written; exit code follows the decision
defects.regression_test: fail-closed path covered by qualifier-chain tests + manual reasoning in test_v40_* additions

defects.evidence: assert_disjoint checked hidden-vs-all and train-validation only; train could overlap retention/security silently
defects.root_cause: coverage gap in the pairwise assertion
defects.repair: pairwise sample-id disjointness across train/validation/retention/security (hidden checks unchanged); V3 adds compositional sample-disjointness vs all and family-disjointness vs hidden/final_holdout; verified all shipped corpora have zero overlaps
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_dataset_v3.py

defects.evidence: the declared primary comparison (L7-L5b) was reported but never gated — a plan could qualify on a different comparison
defects.root_cause: the L7-L5b gate existed only in the sealed-confirmation lane
defects.repair: when the plan's arms contain L7+L5b the qualifier computes per-seed delta_ft_primary and gates mean + Bonferroni-adjusted bootstrap CI against the same preregistered thresholds
defects.regression_test: gate covered by qualifier-chain tests

defects.evidence: the validation partition was bound but never evaluated; no compositional measurement existed
defects.root_cause: runner evaluated hidden/retention/security only
defects.repair: v4.0 corpora (V3 partition schema) evaluate validation (split B within-family) and compositional (split E) blocks in run_eval_block with v3 prediction records; the eval-set digest binds both new partitions; the qualifier rescores them and gates compositional delta vs minimum_compositional
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_dataset_v3.py + rescore block coverage

defects.evidence: n_comparisons_preregistered was signed into the plan but never consumed
defects.root_cause: no consumer was written
defects.repair: the family-clustered CI gate now uses Bonferroni-adjusted alpha (ci_alpha / n_comparisons_preregistered) and records both alphas; the L7-L5b primary gate applies the same divisor
defects.regression_test: Bonferroni fields asserted in stats; qualifier tests green

defects.evidence: INTERVENTION_SELECTION.json was a campaign-specific analysis artifact; nothing programmatically mapped failure evidence to interventions, refused repeated failures, or accounted cost
defects.root_cause: never implemented as a reusable mechanism
defects.repair: controller: FailureEvidence -> diagnose() (10 hypothesis categories with evidence-tagged confidence) -> select_intervention() (cost- and history-aware scoring, anti-repeat refusal unless changed_condition documented, no_intervention always eligible, candidate_controlled=True markers) -> InterventionRecord history (append-only JSONL); all decision fields the evidence format requires are present and digest-bound
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_controller.py (10 tests)

defects.evidence: the only live router (kvcontinual AdapterRouter) is lexical overlap — no family binding, no model-revision binding, no qualification check, no OOD abstention, no recorded fallback, no rollback
defects.root_cause: routing predates the qualification substrate
defects.repair: VerifiedAdapterRouter: QualifiedAdapterManifest binds adapter/model/scorer/qualification-evidence digests + qualified families; routing requires family eligibility (explicit hint or lexical overlap), enforces OOD threshold, abstains to frozen fallback, suspends on rolling health, supports revoke/reinstate (new evidence required) and snapshot/rollback; every decision emits a structured event; rollback restores adapter snapshots but NEVER undoes revocations (safety actions persist across rollback; test_v40_routing pins this)
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_routing.py (12 tests)

defects.evidence: no standalone component rejected incomplete/inconsistent matrices on all required axes
defects.root_cause: the check was a side effect of receipt iteration
defects.repair: MatrixSpec + audit_matrix enumerate required cells (seeds x arms x required + per-arm cells), verify identity-field consistency (model/tokenizer/evaluator/environment/dataset digests) against bound values, and return COMPLETE/INCOMPLETE/INCONSISTENT; wired into the qualifier's matrix_audit record field; an INCONSISTENT audit (identity disagreement across committed cells) now fails the qualification — it is a gate, not only a record
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_completeness.py (7 tests)

defects.component: preservation levers in the signed protocol
defects.evidence: rehearsal_fraction/kl_weight/kl_every existed in LoraTrainSpec but the signed protocol could not express them
defects.root_cause: protocol schema predates the preservation levers
defects.repair: ExperimentProtocolV2 (new digest-stable schema; V1 untouched so executed-campaign digests stay valid) adds rehearsal_corpus/kl_corpus/require_verified_rehearsal/minimum_compositional/minimum_basemodel_eval_rate/primary_comparison/n_comparisons/rehearsal_fraction/kl_weight/kl_every; lora_train_spec_kwargs forwards the levers; run_campaign1 loads declared corpora, refuses missing/empty bound corpora, binds their digests into PRESERVATION_CORPORA.json, and feeds verified rows to train_lora
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_trainer_protocol.py (protocol tests)

defects.evidence: only single fixed-rank LoRA existed; task-conditioned selection and per-family adapters were absent
defects.root_cause: never implemented
defects.repair: train_family_adapters produces parameter-isolated per-family adapters (fresh base load per family — no stacking); scripts/capability_matrix.py executes the strategy matrix {frozen, fixed, rehearsal, kl, both, routed_family, skill_memory(DELEGATED)} where routed_family is evaluated through VerifiedAdapterRouter (hidden rows abstain to frozen; activation there is a routing error); strategies share one verified pipeline so cells are comparable
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_trainer_protocol.py (family-adapter tests) + tests-python/v161/test_v40_routing.py

defects.evidence: casefold-era reported metrics could not be reproduced under strict scoring
defects.root_cause: v1 oracle inflation (e.g. adapted.hidden 0.5 reported vs 0.333 strict)
defects.repair: scripts/requalify_executed_campaign.py verifies every run's RUN_COMMIT file inventory byte-for-byte and strict-rescores all committed predictions: 12/92 VERIFIED (the c3b3 strict-era runs), 80/92 INCONSISTENT (v1-reported, superseded by strict rescore — not evidence of new defects); written to results/REQUALIFICATION_STATUS.md
defects.regression_test: requalification output committed

defects.evidence: a baseline emitting empty output on most hidden prompts makes the within-family comparison NOT_ESTIMABLE — silence is not a measured zero
defects.root_cause: no gate existed for baseline evaluability
defects.repair: protocol v2 field minimum_basemodel_eval_rate; qualifier recomputes the frozen-L1 non-empty rate from committed hidden predictions and refuses below the bound; offline probe over all committed frozen predictions measured 4236/4236 (1.000) non-empty — the executed evidence is unaffected
defects.regression_test: gate + probe output committed

defects.evidence: eval_seconds omitted the compositional block's timing — the v4.0 split-E evaluation cost was uncounted
defects.root_cause: the eval_seconds sum predates the compositional block
defects.repair: eval_seconds now sums hidden+retention+compositional+validation block times
defects.regression_test: covered by qualifier rescore path

defects.evidence: external review: a revoked adapter became selectable after router save/reload — to_json serialized only the adapter list; _revoked, _suspended and _health were silently dropped, and test_registry_roundtrip asserted only adapter survival
defects.root_cause: safety state was never part of the registry schema
defects.repair: registry schema v2 persists adapters + revoked + suspended + health across save/reload; a v1 file cannot prove its pre-save safety state so it loads marked state_complete=False with a recorded registry_warning, and is refused outright under strict_state=True
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_routing.py::test_revocation_survives_registry_roundtrip, test_suspension_and_health_survive_roundtrip, test_v1_registry_load_marks_incomplete_state, test_v1_registry_strict_state_refuses

defects.evidence: external review: the router accepted qualification manifests without independently verifying signed authorization or adapter contents — manifests were bare digests trusted as constructed (capability_matrix minted provisional evidence digests in-process), and nothing checked the on-disk artifact against adapter_digest
defects.root_cause: no signature field or verification policy existed on the manifest; no artifact re-hash was ever performed
defects.repair: manifest schema v2 adds an Ed25519 envelope over the unsigned body (sign/verify, partial-envelope refused); the router accepts manifest_verifier (every manifest must verify), authority (AuthorityRegistry — signer must be authorized for required_role=qualification at check time) and artifact_resolver + artifact_digester (measured artifact digest must equal adapter_digest at register/reinstate/init AND at every from_json reload); ineligible manifests never enter the registry and appear in every decision's refused list; each routing event records which controls were enforced so provisional (unsigned) evidence cannot read as authorized; scripts/sign_adapter_manifest.py is the authority-side signer (refuses re-sign)
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_routing.py (unsigned/wrong-key/wrong-role/artifact-mismatch/missing-artifact/reinstate-recheck tests) + end-to-end sign->admit->persist->revoke flow verified

defects.evidence: external review: routed evaluation used the correct family label supplied by the benchmark — every row was routed with family=r['family'], and an explicit hint in route() bypasses lexical family matching and the OOD gate entirely (score pinned at 0.85+0.15*priority), so the router's real capability (recognizing the family from the request) was never measured; family_terms=(f,) also made the inferred path degenerate
defects.root_cause: evaluation passed gold labels as dispatch metadata and gave adapters only their family id as routing vocabulary
defects.repair: routed_family_eval now runs BOTH routing modes per row: inferred (no hint — lexical family_terms overlap + OOD threshold; production-realistic; designated result_of_record) and hinted (gold label as dispatch metadata — diagnostic); per-mode accuracy, activation, correct_selection and false_activations are reported separately; family_terms are derived from each family's task instruction text; artifact_resolver+artifact_digester verify adapter contents at registration
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_routing.py (inferred-path tests) + matrix output schema carries both modes

defects.evidence: external review: the split named 'validation' contains families (val3-rot2, val3-first-third, val3-append-tag) disjoint from every trained tr3-* family — no partition in that corpus measures unseen inputs of TRAINED families; the register's 'validation (split B within-family)' wording was inaccurate
defects.root_cause: the generator designed validation as a held-out-family set, conflating cross-family transfer with within-family generalization
defects.repair: scripts/gen_campaign3e.py generates configs/campaign3e_tasks.jsonl + configs/holdout/campaign3e_holdout.jsonl where validation is the trained tr3-* functions on word-disjoint unseen inputs (checked: validation families == train families AND 0 input words shared with train); shipped campaign3b corpus is byte-identical (executed-campaign digests stay valid); new config configs/campaign3e.yaml binds the new sealed holdout digest; cross-family transfer remains measured by hidden + sealed holdout
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_campaign3e_corpus.py (within-family invariants, generator--check, committed-file fidelity, shipped-corpus defect pinned as real and confined)

defects.evidence: the runner collected and scored only train-subset and hidden rows; corpora carrying a validation or compositional split (campaign3e, DatasetPartitionSetV3) had those surfaces generated on disk but never evaluated by this lane — the V4-24 within-family corpus was unreachable as a measurement
defects.root_cause: eval blocks were hardcoded to (subset, hidden) when the corpus schema gained additional splits later
defects.repair: runner now collects split == validation and split == compositional, generates frozen + adapted predictions for both before the frozen reference is freed, scores under the same strict oracle, writes PREDICTIONS-{FROZEN,ADAPTED}-{VALIDATION,COMPOSITIONAL}.jsonl, and reports per-split accuracy plus a within-family / untrained-family decomposition of validation rows; empty splits add no artifacts so legacy-corpora run inventories are unchanged
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_fit_runner_integrity.py (test_within_family_and_compositional_splits_are_evaluated, test_frozen_evaluation_precedes_reference_freeing)

defects.evidence: staging dir was named .staging-{run_id} and shared between concurrent attempts (each rmtree'd the other's evidence); failure cleanup could rmtree(final_dir) and os.replace over it, so a failed attempt could delete or replace another attempt's committed run; publication was a check-then-create race
defects.root_cause: lifecycle derived directory names from the run id alone and treated os.replace as the atomicity guarantee
defects.repair: run_reservation.py: atomic os.mkdir claim under .claims/<run_id>/, ownership-bound staging .staging/<run_id>.<attempt_id> created exclusively and never reused, durable RUN_COMMIT before publication, publish() is a guarded rename that refuses an existing destination, fail() preserves evidence as <run_id>.FAILED-<attempt_id> and releases the claim — a failed attempt cannot delete, replace, or burn another attempt's evidence or the canonical name
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_concurrent_run_lifecycle.py (two-attempt claim, coexistence, no-overwrite, CLI claim-loss exit before model load) + test_fit_runner_integrity.py lifecycle assertions

defects.evidence: the v4.0.1 requalifier rescored only PREDICTIONS-{FROZEN,SUBSET,ADAPTED}.jsonl; the v4.0.1 VALIDATION/COMPOSITIONAL split files were never independently verified, so a wrong committed number there would pass requalification; the evidence manifest recorded 96 hidden rows where the committed corpus/files carry 192
defects.root_cause: the verifier predated the per-split surfaces and did not reconstruct the expected prediction-file set from CONFIG
defects.repair: verify_run: commit-inventory hashing, expected-file-set reconstruction from CONFIG split counts, unique-id/duplicate/unexpected-prediction checks, corpus join (split membership, prompt_sha256, expected), strict rescore of EVERY committed prediction file incl. within/untrained-family decomposition and capability-destruction id lists, and identity bindings (commit<->config digests, adapter manifest<->bytes<->training receipt/spec, model id+revision, contract digests, scorer identity); unparseable or missing evidence records a verdict, never a crash
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_evidence_reconciliation.py (clean VERIFIED run + 8 tamper classes) + results/REQUALIFICATION_STATUS.md (95 runs: 2 VERIFIED campaign3e, 93 INCONSISTENT legacy-v1-oracle)

defects.evidence: registry v2 stored revoked/suspended/health as unsigned unsequenced JSON — deleting a revocation from the file silently restored access and an older valid snapshot could roll safety state back; adapter bytes were verified at registration/reload but not at activation; model_revision was optional; an externally supplied family hint was trusted dispatch metadata any caller could forge
defects.root_cause: the manifest signature bound one manifest but nothing bound the registry's mutable safety state, and the activation-time binding chain (qualification -> digest -> model revision -> authorization -> activation) was not re-verified at use
defects.repair: registry schema v3 seals safety state under an authority signature + monotonic seq (seal_state/open_state); strict_state requires authenticated state; min_seq refuses stale snapshots; an append-only signed RevocationLog is unioned over the file's list so deletion cannot restore access; artifact bytes are re-hashed inside route() (recheck_at_activation, failure marks the adapter ineligible and emits activation_recheck_failed); model_revision required by default; family hints untrusted unless family_authenticated=True
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_registry_tampering.py (deleted revocation fails closed, stale seq refused, forged log entries rejected, unsigned state flagged) + test_activation_authority.py (tampered weights at activation, forged hints, missing identity)

defects.evidence: an unknown --strategies entry printed a warning and continued, and a FAILED cell still exited 0 — CI could report a partially-executed or mis-specified matrix as a completed comparison
defects.root_cause: diagnostic-warn semantics where the output contract required terminal failure
defects.repair: unknown strategies exit 2 before any work; a FAILED cell exits 1 after persisting the matrix record
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_fit_runner_integrity.py CLI-behavior pins + manual invocation; matrix records persist status per cell

defects.evidence: a present cell that could not name its model/tokenizer/evaluator/environment/dataset digests still counted toward matrix completeness — empty digests could yield COMPLETE
defects.root_cause: identity fields were only consistency-checked, never required
defects.repair: MatrixSpec.required_identity_fields (default: all five) — a present cell with an absent required field is an identity violation and blocks COMPLETE; _id_of maps the v3 receipt's evaluation_dataset_digest onto dataset_digest; the qualify_campaign1 _V3Cell view exposes the same alias
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_v40_completeness.py (empty digests and partially-absent fields refuse COMPLETE)

defects.evidence: record --verified accepted a bare boolean — an operator could mark any intervention outcome verified with no checkable evidence behind it, and the controller's prior-failure refusal then treated it as verified memory
defects.root_cause: the verified flag was asserted by the recorder, not established by an independent check
defects.repair: --verified requires --receipt naming independently verifiable evidence: a committed run dir (RUN_COMMIT inventory + COMPLETE status + metrics present) or a signed receipt document verified against --trust-root; failed verification refuses to record a verified outcome; the history entry carries receipt_digest so the claim is re-auditable; InterventionRecord gained receipt_digest
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_activation_authority.py (committed-run, unsigned/unverifiable/forged receipt paths)

defects.evidence: a self-authored run containing METRICS.json and a hash-consistent RUN_COMMIT.json was accepted as verified, and --delta/--retention-drop/--cost values supplied by the caller could ride alongside it into verified controller history
defects.root_cause: receipt verification conflated file integrity with independent evaluation; the CLI trusted operator-supplied numbers
defects.repair: verification states separated (INVALID/INTEGRITY_VERIFIED/EVALUATION_VERIFIED/QUALIFIED); only independent strict rescore of every committed prediction surface plus identity bindings, or a signed evaluator/qualification document, is admissible; qualified_outcome.derive_qualified_outcome derives every numeric field from evidence and emits an immutable record; the CLI refuses caller-supplied numbers on verified paths (manual numbers only under explicit --diagnostic, verified=false); signed qualification decisions must bind run_id + evidence_digest under a 'qualification'-role key
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_qualified_outcomes.py (fabricated 999 delta, self-authored commit, forged/unauthorized qualification signatures, tampered predictions/model identity, CLI refusal paths); tests-python/v161/test_activation_authority.py updated to the tiered contract

defects.evidence: the signed registry snapshot could be rolled back to any previously-signed seq by a caller-supplied min_seq, and the revocation-only ledger could not represent a requalified generation — reinstatement had no durable signed history
defects.root_cause: no separately-held authoritative head bound the newest accepted state; safety history recorded revocations but not the full transition set
defects.repair: RegistryEventLog: signed hash-chained transition ledger (REGISTERED/QUALIFIED/REVOKED/REQUALIFIED/SUSPENDED/RESTORED) binding adapter id, qualification generation, artifact digest, model revision, previous event digest and monotonic seq; legal transitions enforced on fold and a broken chain is never folded. RegistryStateAuthority: separately-custodied signed head binding (seq, state_digest, event-head), monotonic on record; production loads under require_authority fail closed when the head is missing, stale, or disagrees — including a truncated/absent ledger. Manifests carry qualification_generation; a stale-generation manifest cannot activate or re-register
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_registry_state_machine.py (register->revoke->restart blocked; deleted ledger refused; stale snapshot refused; revoke->requalify->restart active; suspend->restart blocked; forged requalification blocked; monotonic head; chain tamper detection)

defects.evidence: run_id/attempt_id had no filename-safe grammar (separators, '..', absolute paths, control characters accepted), symlinked infrastructure was not rejected, and publication used check-then-rename which could replace an existing empty directory
defects.root_cause: identifiers became path components without validation; rename-on-directory semantics replaced empty targets
defects.repair: IDENT_RE grammar (^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$) enforced before any filesystem access, '.'/'..' refused, resolved-parent containment under run_root verified, symlinked .claims/.staging refused, destination symlink refused; publish now creates the canonical name with os.mkdir (atomic no-replace nonce) and moves staging entries in with RUN_COMMIT.json last — a crash mid-populate leaves an uncommittable name, never a replaced run
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_evidence_hardening.py (identifier battery, symlink refusal, planted-dir publish refusal) + tests-python/v161/test_concurrent_run_lifecycle.py

defects.evidence: the metrics comparison skipped any check whose reported value was absent — a COMPLETE run missing required accuracy fields, or carrying non-finite/out-of-range values, could still verify; an unparseable RUN_COMMIT crashed the verifier
defects.root_cause: permissive missing-value behavior instead of an experiment metric schema
defects.repair: required-metric schema: when a committed prediction surface rescored, its reported counterpart is mandatory — absent, non-numeric or outside [0,1] is INCONSISTENT; capability_destruction accounting (n_frozen_correct_hidden, destroyed_ids, gained_ids plus count/list consistency) is required on hidden-surface runs; all committed JSON files are parse-guarded — a truncated commit or metrics file resolves to INVALID/INCONSISTENT, never a crash and never VERIFIED
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_evidence_hardening.py (missing field, missing accounting, out-of-range/non-numeric metrics, truncated commit, missing/duplicated/unexpected predictions, wrong corpus answers)

defects.evidence: the requalification report enumerated only runs that happened to be on disk — an empty collection or a silently missing historical run still produced a clean report with exit 0
defects.root_cause: no expected-run manifest and no evidence requirement gated the report
defects.repair: --expected-manifest enumerates every expected historical run id with an optional expected status; missing runs and status mismatches fail; --strict-completeness also fails on run dirs absent from the manifest; --require-evidence fails when the collection is empty or a COMPLETE run rescored zero prediction files; any failure exits 2 and is printed to stderr and the report
defects.regression_test: tests-python/v161/test_evidence_hardening.py (empty campaign refused, missing manifest entries fail, status mismatch fails, complete manifest passes)

defects.evidence: torch/yaml/peft and the runtime modules were imported before --adapter arguments were validated — invalid arguments could not be rejected without the optional training stack importing successfully
defects.root_cause: argument validation ordered after heavy optional imports
defects.repair: --adapter NAME=PATH validation and the required-adapter check now run before torch/peft imports
defects.regression_test: manual: --adapter BADSPEC and bare invocation reject with exit!=0 and no peft import

residual_known_limitations: Governance custody: the release/authority keys are development-machine held; no multi-party approval or HSM custody exists. Cryptographic mechanisms are real; operational custody is a documented limitation, not a claim.
Deployment isolation: a learner that escapes the model-code sandbox could in principle read role keys on the same host; OS-level isolation is the declared control and is NOT independently verified.

The colab campaign lane (run_campaign1.py) still requires CUDA for full campaign execution; the v4.0 additions were verified by unit/integration tests plus the CPU/MPS positive-control run, not by a new full campaign.
INTERVENTION_SELECTION.json (3B.3 analysis) remains a campaign-specific artifact; capability_controller.py is the general mechanism it inspired — they are not the same component.
